interpretation: D is dated standing guidance. T adds the complete frozen PR discussion and outcome metadata. I adds commit-pinned proposals, patches, merge records, technical context and linked public meeting evidence. I is an evidence expansion, not merely software implementation. Every assessment is retrospective by the same continuing analyst; no independent source-restricted runs occurred.
